name: London
summary: Mix free museum time with one or two paid historic sights. Group days by area so underground travel does not consume the visit.
seasonNote: Rain is possible all year; summer and school holidays are crowded, while winter daylight is short.
arrival: Identify the airport first: Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton and City have different routes and fares.
gettingAround: Use contactless or Oyster where supported; use the same card or device for entry and exit. Walk adjacent river districts.
cashTip: Cards dominate; a small GBP reserve is sufficient for many visits. Check foreign-card conversion fees.
foodTip: Try market lunches, a full breakfast or a neighbourhood curry; queues are not a quality guarantee.
buyTip: Browse independent design, books and food gifts; compare souvenir pricing away from major landmarks.
baseArea: Bloomsbury, South Bank or another well-connected central district

connections.note: Approximate train time; arrive early for required check-in and border formalities.

items.name: CORE by Clare Smyth
items.summary: Clare Smyth’s three-star restaurant in Notting Hill, celebrating British produce in a relaxed, polished room.
items.expect: A long tasting-menu meal. Deposits, cancellation fees and smart-casual dress codes are common at this level.
items.tip: Book through the restaurant’s own site or official booking partner as soon as your dates are set.
items.priceNote: Our rough per-person planning estimate for a tasting menu at this level in London, scaled from the city’s daily budget. Not a menu quote: check the restaurant’s own site, and allow for drinks, service and tax.
items.bestTime: Lunch or dinner by reservation; check the current service days
whyVisit: Clare Smyth’s three-star restaurant in Notting Hill, celebrating British produce in a relaxed, polished room.
The MICHELIN Guide awards it Three MICHELIN Stars (exceptional cuisine), the guide’s highest award.
visitFlow: Book through the restaurant’s own site or official booking partner as soon as your dates are set.
Share allergies and dietary needs when booking; tasting menus are hard to change on the night.
Allow about three hours and plan a taxi or short walk back.
items.tradeoffs: Among the most expensive meals of a trip, and tables can sell out weeks or months ahead. Menus are set by the kitchen.

dietary.note: No dietary evidence collected yet. Ask the restaurant directly about halal, vegetarian and allergy needs; tasting menus need notice.
